recommendation: Keep the core audit as-is. If the work group wants more exact FHIR-48918 scope or boundary narrative in the current DeviceUsage artifact, make that follow-up in HL7/oo-incubator rather than FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-48918 asked to let DeviceUsage.informationSource reference Device for device-reported use. The Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification disposition did not add Device and instead clarified DeviceUsage scope and boundaries for patient-reported or second-hand use and neighboring resources.
initial_application: FHIR core history applied the issue through PR #3637 and FHIR-48918 commits ending at 74fe475c94e02e7ae38748812169da739e498b99, updating source/deviceusage/deviceusage-introduction.xml. The remaining local StructureDefinition keeps DeviceUsage.informationSource targets to Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, RelatedPerson, Organization, and Group, with no Device target.
additional_context: Commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 later removed DeviceUsage from active core registration and changed core module pages to link DeviceUsage to the OO incubator IG. FHIR-51713, a related DeviceUsage clarity issue, is already represented on the combined branch as an external-repo audit. The current OO incubator DeviceUsage artifact also keeps Device out of informationSource.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. The source/deviceusage files are now out of the active core build, so editing them would not change the current core specification; any further DeviceUsage narrative refinement belongs in the OO incubator repository.

related_jiras.note: Cited FHIR-48918 while adding DeviceUsage.partOf for detailed usage relationships; already audited on the combined branch as external-repo.
